name: Remembrance
description: An amber relic, last remnant of the first kin-tree holding the spirits of the first ancestors, shattered by Daghatar.

description_citations.text: "Abzan Houses". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Daghatar learns why Dromoka massacred his people, shatters the Remembrance and ends the kin-tree practices, forging a pact with the dragon.
timeline.quote: he ignored the dictates of the Remembrance spirits and shattered the relic, pleasing the dragon.

citation.text: "Abzan Houses", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
